Summary
: An English summary of the Samarangana-Sutradhara by Bhoja representing a voluminous treatise on the science of Architecture, also known as Vastu-Shastra, encompassing eighty-three chapters in Sanskrit shloka format. The Samaranganasutradhara includes topics predominantly dealing with Architecture, Arts and Crafts, but also deals with Creation-theory, Geography, Iconography.
